items.title: Staff keycard
items.body: Off the counter while nobody was counting. Opens the door behind the tellers. Somebody will notice it gone, but not this morning.

items.title: Office key
items.body: Under the carpet, exactly where the note said it would be. A manager who hides his own key is a manager who expects to be searched.

items.title: Exit keycard
items.body: Opens the side door. It was left where you would find it, which is worth thinking about once you are out on the walkway.

items.title: Taser
items.body: Security locker, standard issue, one cartridge. Enough for one man at close range. There are five of them.

items.title: Moneybag
items.body: Heavier than it looks. Carrying it out of the door makes you one of them in every way a court cares about.

items.title: Notebook
items.body: Names, dates, a six way split with one name circled. Wilco writes everything down. It is the only careless thing about him.
